reason: The type extractor reads a parser, and a parser sees only a string, so it typed these settings as text. The ORE guide lists the values each one accepts, in the Options column of its pricing engine chapter. The guide's list is the vocabulary, so the set states it. A setting whose values one set cannot state stays text, and its description says what the guide allows.
source_ref: projects/ores.seeder/datasets/ore_pricing_engines/pricing_vocabulary.json, the guide's Options column, read from the ORE user guide chapter on the pricing engine configuration

calibration.name: Calibration
calibration.description: Free text: the guide lists Bootstrap, BestFit and None, and the documents the ORE examples ship write Deal, which the guide's list omits. One set cannot state a vocabulary the guide states only in part.
